verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is that Canva lets users access brand kits and keep teams on-brand with Brand Templates. That loosely suggests centrally managed brand styling, but none of the evidence describes tokens or variables for colors, spacing or typography, nor modes or themes applied across designs. missing for 10: documented design tokens/variables for color, spacing and typography, mode/theme switching, propagation of variable changes across designs, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
